title: Kalb-Ramond Topological Term in Majorana Superspace and Kaluza-Klein Spectrum Deformation in Five Dimensions
summary: We construct an intrinsic $N=1$, $D=5$ superspace whose Grassmann coordinate is a five-dimensional Dirac spinor split into two Majorana spinors, $Θ=θ+i\tildeθ$, and use it to analyze the supersymmetric structure of the five-dimensional Kalb-Ramond (KR) topological term. The algebra closes on the fifth momentum through anticommutators of opposite-sector generators, realizing $\partial_5$ as a central charge; this assignment is the unique covariant one, and we give a dictionary to the $N=1/2$ superspace of Linch, Luty and Phillips and to the $N=1$ superform hierarchies of Becker et al.
